from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls, _canonicalize_args
import json

# Task 1: validate_input tests
# 1. Dict with tool_calls key (existing behavior)
result = ToolCalls.validate_input({'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]})
print('Dict with tool_calls:', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]}

# 2. Single object without tool_calls
result = ToolCalls.validate_input({'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}})
print('Single object:', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]}

# 3. Bare list
result = ToolCalls.validate_input([{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'y': 2}}])
print('Bare list:', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'y': 2}}]}

# 4. JSON string - dict with tool_calls
result = ToolCalls.validate_input('{\"tool_calls\": [{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"x\": 1}}]}')
print('JSON string dict:', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]}

# 5. JSON string - single object
result = ToolCalls.validate_input('{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"x\": 1}}')
print('JSON string single:', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]}

# 6. JSON string - bare list
result = ToolCalls.validate_input('[{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"x\": 1}}]')
print('JSON string list:', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]}

# 7. Non-JSON string
result = ToolCalls.validate_input('not valid json at all')
print('Non-JSON string:', result)
assert result == 'not valid json at all'

# Task 2: Fingerprint tests
tc = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'b': 2, 'a': 1})
print('Fingerprint:', tc.fingerprint)
print('ID:', tc.id)
assert len(tc.fingerprint) == 64
assert len(tc.id) == 8
assert tc.fingerprint[:8] == tc.id

# Same call with different arg order should have same fingerprint
tc2 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'a': 1, 'b': 2})
assert tc.fingerprint == tc2.fingerprint, f'{tc.fingerprint} != {tc2.fingerprint}'

# Different call should have different fingerprint
tc3 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='bar', args={'a': 1, 'b': 2})
assert tc.fingerprint != tc3.fingerprint

# from_dict_list should also compute fingerprints
tcalls = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{'name': 'search', 'args': {'query': 'hello'}}])
print('From dict list:', tcalls.tool_calls[0].fingerprint, tcalls.tool_calls[0].id)
assert len(tcalls.tool_calls[0].fingerprint) == 64
assert len(tcalls.tool_calls[0].id) == 8

# Canonicalization tests
assert _canonicalize_args({'b': 1, 'a': 2}) == {'a': 2, 'b': 1}
assert _canonicalize_args(('a', 'b')) == ['a', 'b']
assert _canonicalize_args('  hello  ') == 'hello'
assert _canonicalize_args(42) == 42
assert _canonicalize_args(True) == True
assert _canonicalize_args({'nested': {'z': 1, 'a': [3, (2, 1)]}}) == {'nested': {'a': [3, [2, 1]], 'z': 1}}

print('All tests passed!')
"
